description:
Advances: specled.spec_review

Follow-up from specled_-gai (epic specled_-233, 2026-07-26). Ruled base-parity advisory by cold audit pass 2 and confirmed by verify passes 2 and 3; deliberately NOT actioned in that ticket because hardening it requires logic changes to lib/specled_ex/review/html.ex and test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs, which specled_-gai's Allowed touches restricted to covers-comment repointing.

THE GAP. specled.spec_review.coverage_no_debug_info_distinct_note requires that no_debug_info MFAs 'are not counted or reported as covered or uncovered'. Its covering test (test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs:1391) asserts only that the rendered page SAYS SO — it does not assert the count.

Demonstrated during verification: patching lib/specled_ex/review/html.ex so that

    executed_count = length(covered) + length(no_debug)

makes the renderer report the no-debug MFA as executed in the closure line WHILE STILL printing 'not counted as covered or uncovered', and mix test test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs stays green at 97 tests / 0 failures. So the requirement's central numeric claim has no failure mode; only its disclaimer text does.

WHY THIS IS NOT A specled_-gai DEFECT. At base 402f4a27 the identical clause lived inside the compound specled.spec_review.coverage_tab_bind_closure statement and carried exactly the same evidence — the same test, asserting the same rendered text. specled_-gai relocated the clause into its own requirement id with its own executed verification entry, which is strictly an improvement; it neither introduced nor weakened the gap. Taking ownership of an id does not oblige test-hardening outside a ticket's Allowed touches.

FIX. Add a numeric assertion to the covering test so the count itself is load-bearing — e.g. assert the closure line reports the no-debug MFA as NEITHER covered nor uncovered (assert the expected 'K executed' value, or refute the inflated one). Then verify the fix by falsification: apply the executed_count mutation above and confirm the test goes RED before committing.

WORTH CHECKING WHILE THERE. The same shape may affect the sibling clause in specled.spec_review.coverage_unresolvable_source_renders_distinct_note — confirm whether its 'unqualified'/'not counted' behavior is asserted numerically or only as rendered text.

comments.text: ADMISSION VERIFICATION (specled_-k6s, 2026-07-27) Cold fresh-context verifier run against the epic base tree (feat/specled_-td7-self-identifying-descriptors @ e81f9f98). VERDICT: still_applicable EFFORT: trivial Mandate confirmed still applicable as written; no narrowing needed. == SCOPED REMAINING WORK == All of it. Test-only change in test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs; no lib/ change and no spec change required. A. Harden the no-debug test (test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs:1391-1419, "renders a no-debug-info note when requirement reach lists no_debug_info_mfas"): - Make the fixture mirror the real data-layer shape so the numbers are meaningful: in the `req_reach(...)` call add `uncovered_mfas: []`, `closure_mfa_count: 1`, `closure_coverage_pct: 0.0` alongside the existing `covered_mfas: []` / `no_debug_info_mfas: ["Ghost.Mod.fun/1"]` (matches coverage_closure_test.exs:495-502, the real producer output for a single no-debug MFA). - Add the load-bearing numeric assertion on the closure line rendered by lib/specled_ex/review/html.ex:3039: assert html =~ "Closure: 1 MFA — 0 executed (0.0%)." (exact format: `#{mfa_count} MFA#{plural(mfa_count)} — #{executed_count} executed (#{format_closure_pct(pct)}).`; plural(1) == ""). - Add the cross-label refute for the "never merged into the source-identity-unavailable note" clause: refute html =~ "Source identity unavailable" B. Harden the sibling test (test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs:1421-1452, @tag spec: specled.spec_review.coverage_unresolvable_source_renders_distinct_note): - Same fixture normalization (`closure_mfa_count: 1`, `closure_coverage_pct: 0.0`; covered_mfas/uncovered_mfas already []), per coverage_closure_test.exs:519-524. - assert html =~ "Closure: 1 MFA — 0 executed (0.0%)." # denominator retained, not reported as covered - refute html =~ "No debug info" # "never presented under the no-debug-info label" C. Falsification proof required before commit (the ticket mandates it, and it is the only way to know the assertion is load-bearing). Temporarily patch lib/specled_ex/review/html.ex:3025 to executed_count = length(covered) + length(Map.get(reach, :no_debug_info_mfas, [])) + length(Map.get(reach, :unresolvable_source_mfas, [])) run `mix test test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs`, confirm BOTH new assertions go RED, then revert html.ex to `executed_count = length(covered)` and confirm green. Do not commit the mutation. D. Do NOT edit .spec/specs/spec_review.spec.md — requirement text at :397-413 is already correct and the covering verification entry (:849-864, whole-file `mix test test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs`, execute: true) already routes to these tests. Note the no-debug test carries evidence via a `# covers:` comment (:1390) while the sibling uses `@tag spec:` (:1421); leave that asymmetry alone — it is specled_-gai's settled shape, not this ticket's mandate. == EXPECTED TOUCHES == test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs == RISK NOTES == REALIZATION HASH: no impact. The specled.spec_review spec-meta (.spec/specs/spec_review.spec.md:16-40) declares NO `realized_by` block (`awk '/^```spec-meta/,/^```$/' | grep realized_by` exits 1), and .spec/realization_hashes.json contains no "Html" or "review/html" entries. The html.ex entry at spec_review.spec.md:929 is a `kind: source_file` VERIFICATION entry, not a hashed binding. The realization-drift gate is untouched by this ticket. SHARED REQUIREMENT IDS: this ticket is the only one in the set touching specled.spec_review.coverage_no_debug_info_distinct_note / coverage_unresolvable_source_renders_distinct_note. Grepping all 21 sibling tickets for "html" / "spec_review" surfaced only specled_-vbo (Advances: specled.spec_review; it adds a command-tier verification for specled.spec_review.gh_pages_privilege_separation and will edit the `spec-verification` block of .spec/specs/spec_review.spec.md plus priv/spec_init/workflows/spec_review.yml.eex). SOFT conflict only: ako needs no spec-file edit at all (item D above), and even if an implementer adds one it would be in the requirements block ~:397-413, not vbo's verification block. specled_-ozm's "html" hit is an unrelated HTML-comment-marker lint. No other ticket edits test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs. ORDERING: no dependency on any other ticket; can land in any order within the single PR. GATE COST / FLAKE: test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs is an `execute: true` command target (spec_review.spec.md:849-851), so bare `mix spec.check` re-runs it. Verification of this change is cheap and local (`mix test test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs`, ~97 tests); the mutation-then-revert step in item C is mandatory and must not leak into the commit — an implementer who skips it reproduces the exact defect the ticket is about (an assertion that cannot fail). FIXTURE COUPLING: the shared `req_reach/1` helper at test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs:1154-1167 defaults `closure_mfa_count: 4, closure_coverage_pct: 75.0, covered_mfas: [3 items], uncovered_mfas: ["Mod.d/1"]`. Do NOT change those defaults to fix these two tests — other tests pin them literally (e.g. :1188 `assert html =~ "Closure: 4 MFAs — 3 executed (75.0%)."`, :1192). Override per-test only.
